subject: Quick 30-min demo? — Xactly AI (webinar attendee)
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Webinar lead: Samir Patel (Xactly AI) — quick handoff

Hi Mina / Ben —

Samir registered for last week's "Scaling LLM inference" webinar and indicated interest in a short product walkthrough focused on latency/cost reductions for inference. Quick notes:
- Role: Head of Platform at Xactly AI
- Use case: real-time scoring for financial planning models, heavy embedding workloads
- Self-serve link used: /signup -> no paid usage yet

Can you take this? Suggested ask: 20–30 min walk-through (demo + 2 quick Qs). Recording attached (event-recording.mp4) and I pulled the registration info into the CRM.

Thanks — passing off.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@xactly.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 30-min demo? — Xactly AI (webinar attendee)

Hi Samir —

Thanks for registering for our webinar and for the interest in Redwood. I’m Mina (Account Executive) — would love to run a short 30-minute session tailored to how you’re currently doing model inference for scoring and embeddings.

Proposed focus (30 min):
- 5 min: quick intro & goals
- 15 min: demo (high-throughput serving, batching, and caching)
- 10 min: Q&A + next steps (pricing / dedicated vs hosted)

A few times that work on my side next week:
- Tue Jun 8, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Tue Jun 8, 2:30–3:00 PM PT
- Wed Jun 9, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Alternatively you can pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/mina/redwood-demo-30

I attached a short draft agenda (xactly-demo-agenda.pdf) so you can share with any colleagues.

If none of those times fit, let me know windows that work for you and we’ll adjust.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

---

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@xactly.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 30-min demo? — Xactly AI (webinar attendee)

Thanks Mina — appreciate the follow-up. 30 minutes sounds perfect. Could we do Tue Jun 8 but earlier in the day? My team is on a tight schedule that day. Also can you send a 1-paragraph agenda I can forward to my CTO?

Attending will likely be me + Priya Rao (engineering manager).

Cheers,
Samir
Head of Platform, Xactly AI
samir.patel@xactly.ai

Hi Samir —

Great — we can do Tue Jun 8 at 9:00–9:30 AM PT. I’m locking that slot for you now; please let me know if that will work.

One-paragraph agenda you can forward:
"We’ll do a focused 30-minute session showing Redwood Inference’s runtime optimizations for low-latency scoring and cost-efficient batch/embedding pipelines, followed by 10 minutes of Q&A on deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated) and security controls relevant to regulated finance workloads."

I attached the short agenda PDF and I’ll send a calendar invite (ICS) once you confirm — Calendly link if you prefer self-scheduling: https://calendly.com/mina/redwood-demo-30

Attachments: xactly-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks —
Mina

Samir
